name: Tesmec S.p.A.
summary: Tesmec S.p.A. designs, manufactures, and sells products, technologies, and integrated solutions for the construction, maintenance, and efficiency of infrastructures related to the transport and distribution of energy, data, and material. It operates through Energy, Trencher, and Railway segments.
